messages:
Sasha L.: quick sync — v2 rollout status. aiming to bump canary -> beta lane this week but need clear owners for: python/js SDK header change, runtime perf regression on long-context requests, and a fallback plan if canary latencies spike. can anyone own coordination?
Priya K.: I can take SDK header change (python + node). patch landed in branch `sdk/headers-v2` but need a release + smoke tests. ETA EOD tomorrow. @Marcos R. can you confirm the header acceptance in routing?
Marcos R.: I will validate routing acceptance. current proxy only whitelists `X-Redwood-Client` values; v2 requires `x-redwood-client-v2` too. quick config diff:
```yaml
proxy_headers:
  - X-Redwood-Client
  - x-redwood-client-v2
```
I can push change to staging after Priya cuts a prerelease.
Ben T.: runtime perf regression: saw 15-20% p99 increase on long-context (>8k) with the canary build. root cause looks like KV cache eviction timing change from the new allocator. I'm bisecting now. if it's a blocker we should hold beta expansion.
Carmen J.: If runtime holds beta, can we still expand to internal teams (gamma lane) with traffic split 0.5%? meaning limit public expansion but let product teams test. less blast radius. :thinking_face:
Alice M.: +1 to Carmen. also need migration owners list for comms and SDK deprecation notes. I propose: SDK/Docs - @Priya K.; Runtime/Perf - @Ben T.; Routing/Proxy - @Marcos R.; Rollout ops - @Alice M.; Canary monitoring - @Sasha L.
Sasha L.: that ownership works for me. @devops-bot can you schedule a canary expansion runbook with these owners and create the canary channel?
devops-bot: created #canary-v2-runbook and set calendar event "v2 canary expand" for 2025-05-28T15:00:00Z. runbook template: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/v2-canary (editable).
Priya K.: note for the SDK release: header change is breaking for client-go and some older mobile wrappers. I'm adding a compatibility flag `REDWOOD_CLIENT_LEGACY` that preserves old header until 2025-07-01. will call it out in changelog.
Marcos R.: thanks. I'll add the header whitelist to staging and add e2e asserting header passthrough. can we also add a fallback shim on proxy that maps legacy header to v2 internally? small patch, less risky.
Ben T.: bisect update: narrowed to allocator commit f3a2d — looks like LRU window got smaller under certain seq len distributions. I'll try a patch to widen window and run perf canary baseline. if p99 drops back under target we can proceed.
Carmen J.: I'll coordinate with product teams for the internal gamma lane if runtime patch isn't ready. need an owner to post the short checklist for gamma access (config toggle, API key tag, monitoring link). @Alice M.?
Alice M.: will post gamma access checklist in #canary-v2-runbook by EOD. also drafting the deprecation blurb for v1 endpoints (timeline + recommended client upgrades).
Sasha L.: next steps: 1) Priya releases prerelease tomorrow, 2) Marcos updates staging proxy, 3) Ben lands perf patch or we hold public beta; 4) Alice runs gamma checklist and comms. owners above are primary. I'll follow up with a quick status ping 12h before the calendar event. :thumbsup:
Priya K.: ack. I'll add smoke test matrix to the runbook (auth headers, streaming, function call).
Marcos R.: ack — will add e2e header test and fallback shim PR link to runbook.
Ben T.: ack — will update perf numbers in the canary channel after retries.
Carmen J.: thanks all — tagging cross-team contacts and product owners in the runbook.
Sasha L.: thanks team — closing this thread, will summarize in the runbook and ping again before expansion.
